def main():
    input_line = input().split()
    base = int(input_line[0])
    number = int(input_line[1])
    is_ok = True
    deque_digits = []

    while number != 0:
        deque_digits.insert(0, number % base)
        number //= base

    index = 0
    while index < len(deque_digits):
        digit = deque_digits[index]
        if digit == 0 or digit == 1:
            index += 1
            continue
        if digit == base - 1:
            j = index + 1
            while j < len(deque_digits):
                val = deque_digits[j]
                if val == base - 1:
                    deque_digits[j] = 0
                else:
                    deque_digits[j] = val + 1
                    break
                j += 1
        else:
            is_ok = False
            break
        index += 1

    print("YES" if is_ok else "NO")

main()
